S.FORM: ya na ikapito no toki am ko mangay do gako.
ya na ikapito no toki am ko mangay do gako.
S.PHON: ja na ikapit[o|u] n[o|u] t[o|u]ki am k[o|u] maŋaj ɖ[o|u] gak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我今天七點到學校。
I arrived at school at seven today.

S.FORM: ya mapakzikzing am, ya somdep do pivatvatekan o sinsi namen, maniring o nipamnekan namen a panirsiringen am "tomanek! amlogod."
ya mapakzikzing am, ya somdep do pivatvatekan o sinsi namen, maniring o nipamnekan namen a panirsiringen am "tomanek! amlogod."
S.PHON: ja mapakrikriŋ am ja ʂ[o|u]mɖəp ɖ[o|u] pifatfatəkan [o|u] ɕinɕi namən maniɻiŋ [o|u] nipamnəkan namən a paniɻɕiɻiŋən am t[o|u]manək aml[o|u]g[o|u]ɖ
S.TRANSL: 上課鐘響，老師走進教室，班長說:「起立!敬禮!」
It’s time for class , the teacher walked into the classroom, and the monitor said: “Stand up! Salute!”

S.FORM: "kamina kong" koan namen a ya mazizigton.
"kamina kong" koan namen a ya mazizigton.
S.PHON: kamina k[o|u]ŋ k[o|u]an namən a ja maririgt[o|u]n
S.TRANSL: 我們很有精神的說:「老師好。」
We said loudly, “Hi, teacher.”

S.FORM: macinanao namen am, nanaoen na yamen no sinsi do ipivilavilang no Tao.
macinanao namen am, nanaoen na yamen no sinsi do ipivilavilang no Tao.
S.PHON: maʨinana[o|u] namən am nana[o|u]ən na jamən n[o|u] ɕinɕi ɖ[o|u] ipifilafilaŋ n[o|u] ta[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 上課的時候，老師教我們數字的族語。
In class, the teacher taught us the Yami language of numbers.

S.FORM: namen to macilolo do sinsi a mivilang, namen nianood paa o anood no vilavilang.
namen to macilolo do sinsi a mivilang, namen nianood paa o anood no vilavilang.
S.PHON: namən t[o|u] maʨil[o|u]l[o|u] ɖ[o|u] ɕinɕi a mifilaŋ namən nian[o|u][o|u]ɖ paa [o|u] an[o|u][o|u]ɖ n[o|u] filafilaŋ
S.TRANSL: 我們跟著老師唸，我們唱了數字歌。
We followed the teacher to read, we sang the number song.

S.FORM: ya aro o ko katengengan rana ciriciring no Tao.
ya aro o ko katengengan rana ciriciring no Tao.
S.PHON: ja aɻ[o|u] [o|u] k[o|u] katəŋəŋan ɻana ʨiɻiʨiɻiŋ n[o|u] ta[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我學會好多族語。
I have learned many Yami languages.

S.FORM: ko mangday so araraw a mangay do gako, ko mangday so araraw a macinanao do ciriciring no Tao, ta ipamizing ko jira ama a ka ni ina.
ko mangday so araraw a mangay do gako, ko mangday so araraw a macinanao do ciriciring no Tao, ta ipamizing ko jira ama a ka ni ina.
S.PHON: k[o|u] maŋɖaj ʂ[o|u] aɻaɻaw a maŋaj ɖ[o|u] gak[o|u] k[o|u] maŋɖaj ʂ[o|u] aɻaɻaw a maʨinana[o|u] ɖ[o|u] ʨiɻiʨiɻiŋ n[o|u] ta[o|u] ta ipamiriŋ k[o|u] ʥiɻa ama a ka ni ina
S.TRANSL: 我天天上學，我天天學族語，我要講給爸爸媽媽聽。
I go to school every day, I learn the Yami language every day, and I want to tell my mother.

S.FORM: ngaran ko am si Mamzat.
ngaran ko am si Mamzat.
S.PHON: ŋaɻan k[o|u] am ɕi mamrat
S.TRANSL: 我的名字是Mamzat。
My name is Mamzat.

S.FORM: ngaran ni ama am siaman Manineng.
ngaran ni ama am siaman Manineng.
S.PHON: ŋaɻan ni ama am ɕiaman maninəŋ
S.TRANSL: 我爸爸的名字是siaman Manineng。
My dad’s name is Manineng.

S.FORM: ngaran ni ina am sinan Manineng.
ngaran ni ina am sinan Manineng.
S.PHON: ŋaɻan ni ina am ɕinan maninəŋ
S.TRANSL: 我媽媽的名字是sinan Manineng。
My mother’s name is Manineng.

S.FORM: ya asa ngarnan o kakawakawan ko siciawan ya.
ya asa ngarnan o kakawakawan ko siciawan ya.
S.PHON: ja aʂa ŋaɻnan [o|u] kakawakawan k[o|u] ɕiʨiawan ja
S.TRANSL: 我今年10歲。
I am 10 years old.

S.FORM: ya asa o kaka ko a mehakay, ngaran na am si Manineng, ya asa so ikaroa na ngarnan no kakawakawan na.
ya asa o kaka ko a mehakay, ngaran na am si Manineng, ya asa so ikaroa na ngarnan no kakawakawan na.
S.PHON: ja aʂa [o|u] kaka k[o|u] a məɰakaj ŋaɻan na am ɕi maninəŋ ja aʂa ʂ[o|u] ikaɻ[o|u]a na ŋaɻnan n[o|u] kakawakawan na
S.TRANSL: 我有一個哥哥，他叫Manineng，他今年11歲。
I have a brother, his name is Manineng, he is 11 years old.

S.FORM: ya namen miyangay so pivatvatekan a gako.
ya namen miyangay so pivatvatekan a gako.
S.PHON: ja namən mijaŋaj ʂ[o|u] pifatfatəkan a gak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我們在同一間學校讀書。
We study in the same school.

S.FORM: yaken a ka ni kaka mehakay am, namen teymakey a mianoanood.
yaken a ka ni kaka mehakay am, namen teymakey a mianoanood.
S.PHON: jakən a ka ni kaka məɰakaj am namən təjmakəj a mian[o|u]an[o|u][o|u]ɖ
S.TRANSL: 我和哥哥都喜歡唱歌。
Both my brother and I like to sing.

S.FORM: ko makey a miawawat, no ya miwalam am, namen mangay miawawat a asa ka vahay.
ko makey a miawawat, no ya miwalam am, namen mangay miawawat a asa ka vahay.
S.PHON: k[o|u] makəj a miawawat n[o|u] ja miwalam am namən maŋaj miawawat a aʂa ka faɰaj
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡游泳，放假的時候，我們全家會一起去游泳。
I like swimming. During the holidays, our whole family go swimming together.

S.FORM: ko makey a maciboang do vayo a kagagan, ta apia a kapieza namen a mangay mianoanood a ka no miawawat.
ko makey a maciboang do vayo a kagagan, ta apia a kapieza namen a mangay mianoanood a ka no miawawat.
S.PHON: k[o|u] makəj a maʨib[o|u]aŋ ɖ[o|u] faj[o|u] a kagagan ta apia a kapiəra namən a maŋaj mian[o|u]an[o|u][o|u]ɖ a ka n[o|u] miawawat
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡認識新朋友，我們可以一起唱歌和游泳。
I love meeting new people, we can sing and swim together.

S.FORM: yaken am anak no tao do pongso.
yaken am anak no tao do pongso.
S.PHON: jakən am anak n[o|u] ta[o|u] ɖ[o|u] p[o|u]ŋʂ[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我是達悟族的小孩。
I am an tao child.

S.FORM: namen mivaay do Takaw.
namen mivaay do Takaw.
S.PHON: namən mifaaj ɖ[o|u] takaw
S.TRANSL: 我們家住在高雄。
Our family lives in Kaohsiung.

S.FORM: namen lalima a ka tao do vaay namen.
namen lalima a ka tao do vaay namen.
S.PHON: namən lalima a ka ta[o|u] ɖ[o|u] faaj namən
S.TRANSL: 我們家共有五個人。
There are five people in our family.

S.FORM: namen talo a maketeketeh do vaay namen.
namen talo a maketeketeh do vaay namen.
S.PHON: namən tal[o|u] a makətəkətəɰ ɖ[o|u] faaj namən
S.TRANSL: 我們家有三個兄弟姊妹。
There are three brothers and sisters in our family.

S.FORM: yaken a ka ni ama a ka ni ina a ka nira kaka a ya matovong do vaay namen.
yaken a ka ni ama a ka ni ina a ka nira kaka a ya matovong do vaay namen.
S.PHON: jakən a ka ni ama a ka ni ina a ka niɻa kaka a ja mat[o|u]f[o|u]ŋ ɖ[o|u] faaj namən
S.TRANSL: 我跟爸爸、媽媽、哥哥和姊姊住在一起。
I live with my father, mother, brother and sister.

S.FORM: ya makarang si ama, si ama am mikalsong.
ya makarang si ama, si ama am mikalsong.
S.PHON: ja makaɻaŋ ɕi ama ɕi ama am mikalʂ[o|u]ŋ
S.TRANSL: 我的爸爸很高，我的爸爸是警察。
My father is tall and he is a policeman.

S.FORM: Ya magolang si ina, si ina am koysang.
Ya magolang si ina, si ina am koysang.
S.PHON: ja mag[o|u]laŋ ɕi ina ɕi ina am k[o|u]jʂaŋ
S.TRANSL: 我的媽媽很瘦，我的媽媽是醫生。
My mother is thin and my mom is a doctor.

S.FORM: No ya mian si ama do vaay namen am, na sirisiringen yamen no ciring no tao do pongso.
No ya mian si ama do vaay namen am, na sirisiringen yamen no ciring no tao do pongso.
S.PHON: n[o|u] ja mian ɕi ama ɖ[o|u] faaj namən am na ɕiɻiɕiɻiŋən jamən n[o|u] ʨiɻiŋ n[o|u] ta[o|u] ɖ[o|u] p[o|u]ŋʂ[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 爸爸在家會和我們說族語。
My father speaks the Tao language with us at home.

S.FORM: namen makarakarala do pongso no ya maid o araraw no namen ipiweywalam.
namen makarakarala do pongso no ya maid o araraw no namen ipiweywalam.
S.PHON: namən makaɻakaɻala ɖ[o|u] p[o|u]ŋʂ[o|u] n[o|u] ja maiɖ [o|u] aɻaɻaw n[o|u] namən ipiwəjwalam
S.TRANSL: 我們暑假都會回部落。
We will all go back to the tribe during the summer vacation.

S.FORM: Yaken a ka nira kaka am namen mateneng a manozatoza.
Yaken a ka nira kaka am namen mateneng a manozatoza.
S.PHON: jakən a ka niɻa kaka am namən matənəŋ a man[o|u]rat[o|u]ra
S.TRANSL: 我和兄姊會一起抓青蛙。
My brothers and sisters and I will catch frogs together.

S.FORM: Ko isaray yamen a asa ka vaay.
Ko isaray yamen a asa ka vaay.
S.PHON: k[o|u] iʂaɻaj jamən a aʂa ka faaj
S.TRANSL: 我很喜歡我們家的人。
I like our family very much.

S.FORM: no ka madagdag ya am namen niamlivon si ina.
no ka madagdag ya am namen niamlivon si ina.
S.PHON: n[o|u] ka maɖagɖag ja am namən niamlif[o|u]n ɕi ina
S.TRANSL: 今天上午我和媽媽去環島。
I went out with my mother today.

S.FORM: ya mowgaraw o angit no ya maraw, o kakawan am ya ji arekmeh a ya ji annget, a ya masazowsaw.
ya mowgaraw o angit no ya maraw, o kakawan am ya ji arekmeh a ya ji annget, a ya masazowsaw.
S.PHON: ja m[o|u]wgaɻaw [o|u] aŋit n[o|u] ja maɻaw [o|u] kakawan am ja ʥi aɻəkməɰ a ja ʥi anŋət a ja maʂar[o|u]wʂaw
S.TRANSL: 白天的天空很藍，天氣不冷也不熱，風很涼爽。
The sky is blue during the day, the weather is neither cold nor hot, and the wind is cool.

S.FORM: namen mian do Jipanatosan am, namen kanen o mavaw namen, o zezak am ya tomiray do kataotao namen a ya ikehteng.
namen mian do Jipanatosan am, namen kanen o mavaw namen, o zezak am ya tomiray do kataotao namen a ya ikehteng.
S.PHON: namən mian ɖ[o|u] ʥipanat[o|u]ʂan am namən kanən [o|u] mafaw namən [o|u] rərak am ja t[o|u]miɻaj ɖ[o|u] kata[o|u]ta[o|u] namən a ja ikəɰtəŋ
S.TRANSL: 我們在雙獅岩吃著點心，陽光灑在身上，非常溫暖。
We ate bread on the grass, the sun was shining on us, and it was very warm.

S.FORM: ya makoyab am, ya mipabazangbang rana o angit.
ya makoyab am, ya mipabazangbang rana o angit.
S.PHON: ja mak[o|u]jab am ja mipabaraŋbaŋ ɻana [o|u] aŋit
S.TRANSL: 下午，天空變紅了。
In the afternoon, the sky turned red.

S.FORM: ko pacicin si ina am, "ya na ikabazangbang no angit ang?"
ko pacicin si ina am, "ya na ikabazangbang no angit ang?"
S.PHON: k[o|u] paʨiʨin ɕi ina am ja na ikabaraŋbaŋ n[o|u] aŋit aŋ
S.TRANSL: 我問媽媽:「為甚麼天空是紅色的。」
I asked my mother why the sky is red.

S.FORM: maniring si ina am "ala ya amian so pagpag a ya mai."
maniring si ina am "ala ya amian so pagpag a ya mai."
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ ɕi ina am ala ja amian ʂ[o|u] pagpag a ja mai
S.TRANSL: 媽媽說:「可能是颱風要來了。」
Mom said, maybe the typhoon is coming.

S.FORM: ya mahep rana am abo rana o cinalab do angit, ya mitotoaw rana o mata no angit.
ya mahep rana am abo rana o cinalab do angit, ya mitotoaw rana o mata no angit.
S.PHON: ja maɰəp ɻana am ab[o|u] ɻana [o|u] ʨinalab ɖ[o|u] aŋit ja mit[o|u]t[o|u]aw ɻana [o|u] mata n[o|u] aŋit
S.TRANSL: 晚上天上沒有雲，星星出來了。
There were no clouds in the sky at night, and the stars came out.

S.FORM: ya namen mangay rana do vahay namen.
ya namen mangay rana do vahay namen.
S.PHON: ja namən maŋaj ɻana ɖ[o|u] faɰaj namən
S.TRANSL: 我們也要回家了。
We were going home too.

S.FORM: namen mian pa do rarahan am, ko patanangen o nakenakem ko do mata no angit.
namen mian pa do rarahan am, ko patanangen o nakenakem ko do mata no angit.
S.PHON: namən mian pa ɖ[o|u] ɻaɻaɰan am k[o|u] patanaŋən [o|u] nakənakəm k[o|u] ɖ[o|u] mata n[o|u] aŋit
S.TRANSL: 在回家的路上，我跟星星許願。
On the way home, I made a wish with the stars,

S.FORM: inaoy no ji ngai o kakawan, ta ko akzeben pa a kalivon.
inaoy no ji ngai o kakawan, ta ko akzeben pa a kalivon.
S.PHON: ina[o|u]j n[o|u] ʥi ŋai [o|u] kakawan ta k[o|u] akrəbən pa a kalif[o|u]n
S.TRANSL: 希望颱風不要來，我還想再環島。
I hope the typhoon doesn't come, I still want to go out to play again.

S.FORM: ya mian do katangked no vahay namen o gako ko, ko mangday so araraw a ya malam a mangey do gako, no ya misiasiay am ko malam a moli do vahay namen.
ya mian do katangked no vahay namen o gako ko, ko mangday so araraw a ya malam a mangey do gako, no ya misiasiay am ko malam a moli do vahay namen.
S.PHON: ja mian ɖ[o|u] kataŋkəɖ n[o|u] faɰaj namən [o|u] gak[o|u] k[o|u] k[o|u] maŋɖaj ʂ[o|u] aɻaɻaw a ja malam a maŋəj ɖ[o|u] gak[o|u] n[o|u] ja miɕiaɕiaj am k[o|u] malam a m[o|u]li ɖ[o|u] faɰaj namən
S.TRANSL: 我的學校在我們家旁邊，我天天走路去學校，也走路回家。
My school is next to our house, I walk to school every day, and I also walk home.

S.FORM: ya alikey o gako namen, ya abo do na ka aro no ya mivatvatek a kakanakan, so namen ipakasingkad do kadoan jiamen.
ya alikey o gako namen, ya abo do na ka aro no ya mivatvatek a kakanakan, so namen ipakasingkad do kadoan jiamen.
S.PHON: ja alikəj [o|u] gak[o|u] namən ja ab[o|u] ɖ[o|u] na ka aɻ[o|u] n[o|u] ja mifatfatək a kakanakan ʂ[o|u] namən ipakaɕiŋkaɖ ɖ[o|u] kaɖ[o|u]an ʥiamən
S.TRANSL: 我們學校不大，沒有很多學生，大家互相認識。
Our school is not big, there are not many students, everyone knows each other.

S.FORM: namen maloalovot do rako a inaorod no gako namen a ya mibozo a ya mawalawalam.
namen maloalovot do rako a inaorod no gako namen a ya mibozo a ya mawalawalam.
S.PHON: namən mal[o|u]al[o|u]f[o|u]t ɖ[o|u] ɻak[o|u] a ina[o|u]ɻ[o|u]ɖ n[o|u] gak[o|u] namən a ja mib[o|u]r[o|u] a ja mawalawalam
S.TRANSL: 所有小朋友會聚在操場，一起玩球、一起聊天。
All the children will gather in the playground, play ball and chat together.

S.FORM: sia mai a macialalam jiamen o sinsi, namen akmey a asa ka vahay a ya mian do gako.
sia mai a macialalam jiamen o sinsi, namen akmey a asa ka vahay a ya mian do gako.
S.PHON: ɕia mai a maʨialalam ʥiamən [o|u] ɕinɕi namən akməj a aʂa ka faɰaj a ja mian ɖ[o|u] gak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 老師們也會和我們一起玩，學校是個大家庭。
The teachers also play with us, the school is one big family.

S.FORM: namen mangday so araraw do gako a ya mivias, ta namen pingsanan o saad no namen pacinanaoan a vahay.
namen mangday so araraw do gako a ya mivias, ta namen pingsanan o saad no namen pacinanaoan a vahay.
S.PHON: namən maŋɖaj ʂ[o|u] aɻaɻaw ɖ[o|u] gak[o|u] a ja mifiaʂ ta namən piŋʂanan [o|u] ʂaaɖ n[o|u] namən paʨinana[o|u]an a faɰaj
S.TRANSL: 我們每天都要打掃，大家要把教室打掃乾淨。
We have to clean every day, and everyone has to clean the classroom.

S.FORM: tatasa ka tao am ya omlinas do pazezevengan, karoan jiamen am ya mivias.
tatasa ka tao am ya omlinas do pazezevengan, karoan jiamen am ya mivias.
S.PHON: tataʂa ka ta[o|u] am ja [o|u]mlinaʂ ɖ[o|u] parərəfəŋan kaɻ[o|u]an ʥiamən am ja mifiaʂ
S.TRANSL: 有些人去擦窗戶，有些人去掃地。
Some people clean the windows, some sweep the floor.

S.FORM: mangay do sirisiri no gako namen a ya namen avyasan, namen tominanakman o maciavazavazay namen a ya pivazain, so na kawadwad no gako namen a mangday so araraw.
mangay do sirisiri no gako namen a ya namen avyasan, namen tominanakman o maciavazavazay namen a ya pivazain, so na kawadwad no gako namen a mangday so araraw.
S.PHON: maŋaj ɖ[o|u] ɕiɻiɕiɻi n[o|u] gak[o|u] namən a ja namən afjaʂan namən t[o|u]minanakman [o|u] maʨiafarafaraj namən a ja pifarain ʂ[o|u] na kawaɖwaɖ n[o|u] gak[o|u] namən a maŋɖaj ʂ[o|u] aɻaɻaw
S.TRANSL: 我們還會打掃學校的各個角落，大家分工合作，學校每天都很乾淨。
We will also clean every corner of the school. Everyone works together, and the school is very clean every day.

S.FORM: nokakyab am, nimangay ko a ataoen si akay do Jimowrod.
nokakyab am, nimangay ko a ataoen si akay do Jimowrod.
S.PHON: n[o|u]kakjab am nimaŋaj k[o|u] a ata[o|u]ən ɕi akaj ɖ[o|u] ʥim[o|u]wɻ[o|u]ɖ
S.TRANSL: 昨天，我去紅頭部落探望爺爺。
Yesterday, I went to visit my grandpa in the tribe.

S.FORM: ko mownay rana ji nimacita si akay, ko ikapaw iya.
ko mownay rana ji nimacita si akay, ko ikapaw iya.
S.PHON: k[o|u] m[o|u]wnaj ɻana ʥi nimaʨita ɕi akaj k[o|u] ikapaw ija
S.TRANSL: 我很久沒有見到爺爺了，我很想念他。
We haven’t seen each other for a long time and I miss him a lot.
